We offer 3 straightforward plans:
- **Starter**: Free, to build your first agent
- **Professional**: $49/mo with advanced integrations
- **Enterprise**: Custom pricing for massive scale and SLA guarantees.

Yes, absolutely! Kaizech Brain has native **WhatsApp Business integration**. You can connect your number in minutes, set up automated routing, and let your AI agent handle customer inquiries directly on WhatsApp 24/7.

Integration is a breeze! You can embed our web widget with a single line of JavaScript, or hit our REST APIs directly to connect with any existing CRM, ERP, or internal system. We have webhooks and SDKs available.

We support advanced **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**. You can upload PDFs, connect SQL databases, or scrape your website. The agent will ground its answers entirely on your proprietary data securely. Bank-grade multi-tenant data isolation is built-in.
We support custom RAG, advanced Prompt Building, custom API actions, BYOK (Bring Your Own Key), and multi-tenant security isolation out of the box.
Kaizech Brain is an **Agentic AI platform**. We provide an end-to-end multi-tenant architecture for businesses to build, deploy, and manage AI agents, Knowledge RAG pipelines, and smart widgets!
